answer: Each new identity locks a bond equal to 24 hours of median attestation rewards and waits one cooling window while a commit-reveal lottery assigns a survey cell (a knoll ridge, a mesa bench, or similar). Only then can the agent forge a signed measurement of that cell, hashed with their public key and the lottery ticket. A copied proof fails the hash; spawning N fakes therefore requires N locked bonds and N wasted windows, so the attacker's capital and time scale linearly and are slashed if any proof does not verify.
